card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 98 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 13.6 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, VY Sgr: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 98 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 2,702 parsecs away.
